subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale test assertions are repaired and final-head CI is green, should maintainers approve these grouped action revisions across credential-bearing, security, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex workflows?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical and upstream identity is verified, but accepting replacement third-party executable revisions in privileged workflows requires explicit maintainer trust judgment.

options.title: Approve repaired final head
options.body: Accept the grouped revisions after all four assertions are synchronized and every required exact-head check passes.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Review token, CodeQL, Docker/release, repository automation, and Codex action updates in narrower pull requests.

options.title: Hold current revisions
options.body: Defer the group until workflow owners have sufficient upstream and operational confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired final head
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped revisions after all four assertions are synchronized and every required exact-head check passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central workflow guard surfaces and is the strongest history-backed owner for the cross-workflow trust decision.
